Thanks for the intro call earlier — following up with the practical checklist so our onboarding engineers can start work tomorrow. I’ve looped Ben (CS lead) and Jordan (platform eng) for technical alignment. Please see the immediate asks and attachments.

Immediate asks (please reply inline):
- SAML metadata (IdP): entity ID, ACS endpoint, and the URL or file — attach if possible (we can ingest file).
- SCIM scope: confirm whether you need create/update/delete and which attributes you want synced (we provided a mapping template).

- Service account: preferred name, policy (least privilege), token TTL and rotation cadence. Do you require HSM-backed keys?

Attachments: nimbus-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MAP), scim-mapping-template.csv, saml-metadata.xml (sample).

Proposed next steps:

2) Ben/Jordan and your IT admin validate SCIM attributes and test account list (T+2).
3) Dry-run in staging (T+5) then production cutover (T+10 week window).

If you prefer a short sync, we can do a 30-min technical call tomorrow 10–10:30am PT.

Thanks — Monica

On Mon, Jul 30, 2028 at 08:42 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the intro call earlier — following up with the practical checklist so our onboarding engineers can start work tomorrow.

Thanks — engineering notes and what we’ll do from our side: 
- SAML: we’ll ingest the Okta metadata and validate EntityID/ACS. For staging we’ll set session_max_age=3600s and prod 28800s (8h) by default; we can adjust per your policy.
- SCIM mapping: we recommend externalId -> employee_id, userName -> email, active -> active, name.givenName/familyName as usual. We’ll load your scim-mapping-template.csv and mark non-syncable attrs as read-only.
- Service account: we’ll create rwdw-scim-prod with provisioning-only scope and no delete. For staging we’ll create rwdw-scim-staging with 7d TTL. We’ll restrict token usage to your egress CIDRs (54.72.130.0/24).
- IP allowlist: we will add your CIDRs to our outbound ACL for callback and webhooks, and we’ll document the required ports (443 TCP) and expected source header behavior if you NAT.

Planned timeline (engineering):
1) Today: ingest IdP metadata and validate cert (done in morning).
2) Wed: provision staging service account + SCIM dry-run with 10 test users (T+1 day validation).
3) Thu/Fri: address attribute mapping exceptions.
4) Next Tue: production cutover dry-run window (schedule with Ben/Alex).

Deliverables I’ll post to the MAP in Drive: staging credentials (secure link), test user list, and failing attribute report.

—Jordan
